dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, which of you saw the thief?
dialogue.reading: ˈsoʊ, ˈwɪtʃ əv juː ˈsɔː ðə ˈθiːf?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I did. I'm a friend of the woman whose wallet was stolen.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪd. aɪm ə ˈfrɛnd əv ðə ˈwʊmən huːz ˈwɑːlɪt wʌz ˈstoʊlən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. Can you describe his appearance?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kən juː dɪˈskraɪb hɪz əˈpɪrəns?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He was young, maybe twenty-five, and he was wearing a red cap.
dialogue.reading: hiː wʌz ˈjʌŋ, ˈmeɪbi ˈtwɛnti ˈfaɪv, ənd hiː wʌz ˈwɛrɪŋ ə ˈrɛd ˈkæp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He was quite short, about the same height as me.
dialogue.reading: hiː wʌz ˈkwaɪt ˈʃɔːrt, əˈbaʊt ðə ˈseɪm ˈhaɪt əz miː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did he have any tattoos or scars?
dialogue.reading: dɪd hiː ˈhæv ˈɛni tæˈtuːz ɔːr ˈskɑːrz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He had a tattoo of a snake on his arm and a small scar near his eye.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈhæd ə tæˈtuː əv ə ˈsneɪk ɑːn hɪz ˈɑːrm ənd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈskɑːr ˈnɪr hɪz ˈaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's very helpful. There's a man in our files whose tattoo looks the same.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈvɛri ˈhɛlpfəl. ðɛrz ə ˈmæn ɪn aʊr ˈfaɪlz huːz tæˈtuː ˈlʊks ðə ˈseɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Can I see his photo?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? kən aɪ ˈsiː hɪz ˈfoʊtoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. Please look at these photos carefully.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˈpliːz ˈlʊk ət ˈðiːz ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈkɛrfəli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's him! The man whose photo is on the left.
dialogue.reading: ðæts hɪm! ðə ˈmæn huːz ˈfoʊtoʊ ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈlɛft.
